definition.simple: The average result per trade you would get over many trades, if your numbers held.
definition.balanced: Expectancy = [[win-rate]] × average win − loss rate × average loss. It is often given in R. It is arithmetic on your inputs. Real win rates and averages change, and a positive past figure does not guarantee a future one.

example: Example inputs: win rate 40%, average win 2R, average loss 1R. Expectancy = 0.40 × 2 − 0.60 × 1 = +0.2R per trade.
